evidence.description: The setting getter and setter directly use UserDefaults.standard to read and write persistent state.
Event tracking directly obtains the user's tracking preference through User.shared.
The notification callback directly invokes User.shared.updatePushNotificationUserStateWithAnalytics and reads User.shared.analyticsUserState.

candidates.explanation: Analytics obtains operational persistence and user-state dependencies through global singleton access rather than an explicit replaceable dependency boundary. These accesses perform storage and user-state operations, not merely access shared constants.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Analytics exposes a static shared instance containing the mutable instance property tracker.
updateTrackerController visibly replaces the tracker property through Analytics.shared.
The public reset method also replaces the instance's tracker.

candidates.explanation: The mutable tracker property is reachable through the visible Analytics.shared instance and is directly reassigned through that shared access path. No actor isolation or synchronization protects this instance state. The violation concerns tracker, not reassignment of the static shared reference itself.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: makeNetworkConfig selects an endpoint from the URL provider and force-unwraps it when constructing NetworkConfiguration.

candidates.explanation: The selected endpoint is force-unwrapped without a visible check or invariant guaranteeing that either selected provider value is non-nil. A nil endpoint therefore causes a runtime failure.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping
